feature: Brazil 2026 PNI cross-vaccine diphtheria/tetanus toxoid history normalization

clinical_reason.interval_applies_across: vaccines containing both diphtheria and tetanus toxoid components

history_scope_contract.complete: Caller explicitly confirms that all relevant diphtheria/tetanus-containing vaccine history available for the patient has been reconciled.
history_scope_contract.partial: Some relevant history is available but completeness cannot be asserted.
history_scope_contract.unknown: Relevant cross-vaccine toxoid history has not been reliably established.

fail_closed_boundaries: Unknown or partial cross-vaccine history must not be converted into a complete basic-series count.
An unrecognized vaccine/product key is not silently assumed to contain or not contain D/T toxoids.
Potential duplicate D/T-containing records on the same administration date make interval/count evaluation unsafe.
The normalizer does not itself apply the 60-day recommended or 30-day exceptional interval.
The normalizer does not decide whether maternal dTpa is due.
